info.title: EmbodyStar Content Agent
info.description: Stateless A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC service. SendMessage returns the complete published Markdown overview. No persistent tasks, streaming, push notifications, or extended agent card are supported.

post.summary: Retrieve published content through A2A SendMessage
post.description: Use the PascalCase method SendMessage and a ROLE_USER message containing text parts. Each request returns the complete current overview as a direct ROLE_AGENT message. Requests with an id receive a JSON-RPC response; notifications without an id return HTTP 204. Batches contain at most 16 requests. Request bodies are limited to 65536 bytes. Supply A2A-Version: 1.0; the header takes precedence over the same-named query parameter. Missing versions default to the unsupported legacy 0.3 version and produce a version error.

parameters.name: A2A-Version
parameters.description: A2A protocol version. Supply 1.0 here or in the query parameter.

parameters.name: A2A-Version
parameters.description: Fallback protocol version when the header is absent.

200.description: A JSON-RPC result or protocol error. SendMessage succeeds with result.message containing a messageId, contextId, ROLE_AGENT role, and Markdown text part. Invalid parameters use -32602; unknown methods -32601; unknown tasks -32001; push notifications -32003; other unsupported operations -32004; unsupported content -32005; incompatible protocol versions -32009.

204.description: Notification processed; no JSON-RPC response body.

400.description: Malformed JSON or invalid JSON-RPC request envelope.

413.description: Request body exceeds 64 KiB or a batch contains more than 16 requests.

get.summary: Discover the agent's A2A interface and skill

200.description: Public A2A Agent Card with identity, supportedInterfaces, capabilities, media types, and skills.

304.description: The cached Agent Card is current.

200.description: JSON media type, Cache-Control, and ETag headers; no body.

304.description: The cached Agent Card is current; no body.

params.description: SendMessage requires message.messageId, role ROLE_USER, and a nonempty parts array of text parts. Optional configuration.acceptedOutputModes must accept text/markdown. Task references cannot be resolved by this stateless service.
